title: My Tunnel Plan
question: 把今天“连接两地 -> 平台用途 -> 通风方案 -> 安全改进 -> 解决问题”的工程表达，放进 science fair 的模型隧道场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: Our model tunnel would connect the library and the science building. This small platform would serve as a station. Fresh air must come in, so the tunnel needs ventilation. A second tunnel should be built for safety. This would solve the problem of walking outside in heavy rain.
